notes.title: INFEST 1.0 is Here—From the Creators of Rogue Star Rescue!
notes.content:
Hello RSR fans!

If you enjoyed Rogue Star Rescue’s mix of decision-making and action-packed gameplay, you’ll love the strategic depth and intense challenges of INFEST 1.0.

[previewyoutube=SwAHEu8xwdg;full][/previewyoutube]

Like Rogue Star Rescue, INFEST rewards smart thinking, bold strategies, and adapting to fast-paced scenarios. But this time, the stakes are even higher in an alien-infested roguelike deckbuilder with real-time physics and pixel-perfect combat mechanics.

Why INFEST is Perfect for Rogue Star Rescue Fans:
	•	Tactical Depth: Think on your feet, just like in Rogue Star Rescue, but with a new deckbuilding twist.
	•	Dynamic Worlds: INFEST’s procedurally generated worlds will keep you guessing, just like the endless surprises of RSR.
	•	Sci-fi Pixel Adventure: Dive into an alien universe filled with hostile environments and thrilling encounters.

After many years in development, INFEST leaves Early Access today! Be sure to catch the launch discount before it expires :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341560/Infest/

notes.title: 🔥 INFEST is Here! - New Game from Chute Apps 🔥
notes.content:
Hello Rogue Star Rescue players,

We’re thrilled to announce that INFEST, our latest game, has just launched and is now available on Steam!

[previewyoutube=e8zkJGcHRp0;full][/previewyoutube]

Infest is a roguelike deckbuilder where every pixel on the battlefield can burn, freeze, corrode, shock, and melt. Carefully craft your deck and deploy cards to alter the environment, buff your stats, and unleash stunning pixel-by-pixel damage upon your enemies!

If you like RSR we think you'll dig the replayability and style of INFEST. You can wishlist Infest now.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341560/Infest/]Wishlist INFEST On Steam[/url]

Thank you for being part of our gaming community. Your support means the world to us!

The Chute Apps Team

notes.title: V1.4.8 Update + Extraktion 1943
notes.content:
Hello all! 

V1.4.8 has just been released! We've been gathering continuous feedback in this time since V1.0, and we've been using it to improve the game. This update fixes some pesky bugs and adds more balancing to the items and guns. As always if something doesn't feel right let us know and we will make adjustments :)

ALSO

We've been super busy working on our other games. Specifically a spiritual successor to RSR called Extraktion 1943. 

Extraktion 1943 is a roguelite extraction shooter set in Nazi Germany. Survive as a stranded Allied soldier behind enemy lines. Take on the Nazis solo or online with friends, sabotage enemy production, assassinate high-ranking officers, and build your hideout and resistance network. DEATH TO HITLER!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2631080/Extraktion_1943/

Thanks again for continuing to play RSR!

-Carl

notes.title: December Update - What's next for RSR?
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

It's been a great year for RSR and we wanted to extend a THANK YOU to everyone who has played the game, joined the community, and helped us shape the game. We are so glad that the community is going strong and that we have a solid and battle-tested game :)

So what's next?

We will continue to post updates to the game as needed, though I wouldn't expect any major content updates any time soon. The RSR universe feels pretty complete for now (though not ruling out a sequel in the future). 

We have been working hard on prototyping other games the last few months. Specifically we will be releasing[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2242220/Forest_Fire/][b] Forest Fire [/b][/url]next month. It's a bullet-hell roguelite game where you are the Forest Fire, and every pixel physically simulated. It's a hell of a lot of fun and I hope you will [h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2242220/Forest_Fire/]Wishlist it![/url][/h2]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2242220/extras/Dec4-square7.gif?t=1670764113[/img]

Also RSR is currently on sale for 30% off, so it's a good time to finally get your friends in for a round of online co-op ;)

Thanks again for your support and we're looking forward to 2023!

-RSR Team

notes.title: Forest Fire is anounced! Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
Forest Fire is our new roguelite bullet-hell destruction game with a simple objective: Burn as much as possible. This may or may not include; trees, animals, housing, and those pesky humans. Every pixel is physically simulated and will spread your flame far and wide.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2242220/Forest_Fire/][h2]Wishlist Now![/h2][/url]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2242220/extras/Dec4-square7.gif[/img]

[b]Features[/b]

-5 unique levels
-Roguelite style perma-death
-Dozens of painful bullet hell patterns
-Unlockables and persistent level-up system
-Dozens of secrets
-Achievements, stats, and leaderboards

We have been working very hard on this game and are SUPER excited to be releasing it in January. We'll be posting regular updates so be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2242220/Forest_Fire/]Wishlist Forest Fire[/url] to get regular updates.

-RSR team

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! I just wanted to give a quick update of what we’ve been up to the last few months.

We’ve released RSR on Nintendo switch! The certification process was intense but everything is ready to go now on the [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/rogue-star-rescue-switch/]Nintendo e-shop.[/url]

We’ve also released a few updates to RSR V1.4. Mostly stability updates but we’ve also added a few new guns. The game is extremely stable now and well balanced.

Besides RSR we’ve been working on new prototype ideas. We’ve got a lot of exciting stuff in the pipeline and will be busy evaluating new ideas. If you’d like to join the discussion head over to our [url=https://t.co/D6IllAlMVq]discord channel.[/url]

Thanks again for your support and the amazing year we’ve had with RSR. We are looking forward to much more in the year to come :)

-RSR team

notes.title: Tower Defense Survival Mode!
notes.content:
We've just released the new Tower Defense Survival game mode, and it adds a whole new dimension to RSR! 

This separate game mode lets you see how many waves you can survive and really focus on optimizing your TD strategy. And of course it's available in single player, local, and online co-op :) 

We've also added a bunch of other fun features in V1.3, they include: 

You can now pet the dogs, and they will reward you with rampage points
New ability to sell unused ammo
New faster loading times
New trap counter in inventory/map window
It's now easier to avoid falling in pits
New Gambler NPC
New trap challenge rooms
New Synergies 
New Extended Rampage item
New Reloading sounds
New game stats when failing
New survival achievements 
New gun scrolling with controller d-pad

Thanks again for your great suggestions and feedback! If you'd like to show your support drop us a short review and let us know what you think! 

-RSR Team

notes.title: New Trap Perks!
notes.content:
We've added 15 new trap perks to further combat the hordes of Uronian invaders :) Available now in V1.1.5!

They include:

-Boss Killer Spikes
-Fire Spikes
-Lingering Slow Spikes (adds temp slow when triggered)

-Teleport back Slows
-Freeze Slows
-Player Buff Slows (player bullets are stronger when enemies on the slow trap)

-Super Push Walls
-Poison Walls
-Explosive Wall

-Electric Bullet Turrets
-Long range Turrets
-Fragmentation Turrets

-Barrier adjacent placement buff
-Explosive Barriers

Thanks so much for your valuable feedback! We are actively using it to add upon the RSR universe. If you'd like to show your support, leave us a short Steam Review! We greatly appreciate it :)

-RSR Team

notes.title: Major Update V1.1!
notes.content:
It's been a week since we launched V1.0 and we are amazed by the response so far! We've received such great feedback from you, and we've worked hard to implement your suggestions. Here's what's changed since V1.0:

Added more variety between characters, new starting items and abilities!
New camera settings and defaults
New enemy counter for incoming defense waves
New revive teammate indicator
New low performance mode for older computers
New physics so that player doesn’t caught on edges as much
New variant colors for players in multiplayer using the same characters
Companions no longer trigger enemy fragmentation bullets
Optimized room layouts
New dialog tips (Save your traps!)
Selling prices now visible in main ship when dropping
Navigator item now shows secrets
New Run timer in map menu
Improved saving/loading feature
Improved environment enhancements
Many more tweaks and adjustments

We've also got a bunch of fun features in the works for V1.2, including new Trap Perks, as well as new enemy capabilities and synergies. If you want to join the discussion, leave us a post in the community hub or via [url=https://discord.gg/RGrHmeW]discord[/url].

Additionally, if you'd like to help the RSR cause please leave us a short Steam Review, they are extremely useful in these early days. Thanks again for your continued support! We are looking forward to hearing from you :)

-RSR Team

notes.title: Rogue Star Rescue is a fun mix of twin-stick bullet-hell and tower defence out now

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/02/rogue-star-rescue-is-a-fun-mix-of-twin-stick-bullet-hell-and-tower-defence-out-now

notes.title: V1.0 is now released and out of Early Access!
notes.content:
After 2.5 years of development we’d like to thank everyone for a successful and enjoyable Early Access phase! Our small team of 4 has worked tirelessly and RSR is now a well-rounded and fun game that we are proud to release :) 

V1.0 Has a variety of new items, guns, improvements and upgrades. The specific details of which we will leave up to you to discover.

So where to now? This is only just the beginning for RSR! Over the next months we’ll be promoting the game and talking to players, getting RSR out to the world. We’ll likely be releasing a lot more content along the way as well. 

Thanks again for all your support! Feel free to reach out in the community hub. We love hearing from our players!

-RSR team

notes.title: Rogue Star Rescue leaves Steam Early Access on February 4th!
notes.content:
[b]We're excited to announce that Rogue Star Rescue is leaving Steam Early Access on February 4th! [/b]After 2.5 years of steady development, the game is ready for you to enjoy to the fullest.

[i][b]We'll be offering a special launch discount.[/b][/i] So if you'd like to play co-op, share the news with your friends! You can get a discounted copy during the first week of the launch, February 4-11. 

Thank you all for your support during our Early Access stage! Thanks to your feedback, Rogue Star Rescue is a well-balanced game with a huge amount of content that we all can enjoy for years to come!

If you have further suggestions, share them here or on [url=https://discord.gg/RGrHmeW]our Discord[/url]. We're always happy to hear from you! 

-RSR team

notes.title: Alpha Road Map Plan for Early Access
notes.content:
Following the game's release on March 8, we will gradually introduce new worlds, weapons, enemies, items, and features.

To clarify our plans, here is our road map for the following three months:

[u]April 5th[/u]
 
[list]
[*] 3rd Planet will be playable and mostly finalized (Tropical Beach)
[*] Inclusion of more environmental hazards

[*] Additional enemies and boss

[*] Additional polish and refinement
[/list]
 
[u]May 3rd[/u]

[*] 50+ guns and items in total
[*] Additional enemies and boss
[*] 4th soundtrack
[*] 500+ rooms
[*] Additional polish and refinement
[/list]
 
[u]May 31st[/u]
 
[list]

We’d like to note that the roadmap is a living thing and may be changed depending on your feedback and how things progress. We’ll keep you posted here and on [url=https://discord.gg/RGrHmeW]our Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Rogue Star Rescue is out now!
notes.content:
[b]Today is the day: Rogue Star Rescue - Alpha version - is live![/b]

Play as the main hero of the team, use and upgrade traps to defend against the mini-bosses, and explore 300+ rooms on two unique planets. 


[u]About this version:[/u]
	•	Fully playable with gamepad or keyboard+mouse
	•	Roguelite procedural levels with 300+ rooms to explore on 2 unique planets
	•	Play as the main hero of the team
	•	10+ enemies and mini-bosses
	•	30+ guns and passive items and 15+ different traps
	•	Use traps to defend against the mini-bosses
	•	Upgrade your trap strategically with gathered coins 

We’ll be releasing large updates every two weeks, introducing new worlds, enemies, items, guns, soundtracks, and many other cool features, both planned and suggested by you.  


For your convenience, we've added a countdown to the start screen in the game, so you’ll know when to anticipate the next update. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34556927/30dadc8f89af45683ad5e62115e5faa32a91c53a.png[/img]


For any questions/feedback, you can [url=https://discord.gg/RGrHmeW]reach us on Discord[/url].
